name: Lady Lucretia's Mendacious Malpractice
source:
About a hundred years ago, one Penelope Belivet walks into the office of intrepid lady psychoanalyst Lucretia Gilman. Lucretia can't seem to cure Penny's melancholia, even as her fondness for her patient grows stronger and stronger. Perhaps if she could act upon her desire, it could improve Penny's outlook? It's a shame that the repressive era she lives in makes it so difficult to do so...

About a hundred years ago, one Crocus manifests into the basement of intrepid man psychoanalyst Oliver Crawford. Crocus can't seem to figure out why this era refuses to grant women the freedom to love each other, even as Lucretia and Penny grow closer and closer on the floor above it. Perhaps if it could convince Lucretia to act upon her desire, she could inspire other women to do the same? It's a shame that Lucretia and Penny have such a difficult time understanding each other's needs...
